stories.title: Tron's USDT Supply Hits $87.9B as Q2 Transfers Reach $2.1 Trillion
stories.summary: A Messari report cited by Cointelegraph shows Tether's USDT supply on the Tron network reaching $87.9 billion, with $2.1 trillion in transfers moving across the chain in the second quarter. The figures underscore Tron's continued role as a primary settlement rail for dollar-pegged stablecoins.
stories.whyItMatters: Tron's outsized share of USDT issuance and transfer volume makes it a key node for global stablecoin liquidity, which matters for both market plumbing and regulatory attention on stablecoins.
whatToWatch: Whether USDT supply on Tron keeps growing next quarter
Any regulatory commentary on stablecoin concentration by chain
questions: What is driving the transfer volume — remittances, exchange settlement, or arbitrage?
Is issuance growth matched by verified reserve backing?

sources.title: TRON USDT supply hits $87.9B as transfers reach $2.1T in Q2: Messari

stories.title: BTCPay Server Offers 3 BTC Bounty After Wallet Exploit
stories.summary: BTCPay Server is offering a bounty of 3 bitcoin for information leading to recovery of funds stolen in a wallet exploit. The open-source, self-hosted bitcoin payment processor is used by merchants who want to accept BTC without a custodial intermediary.
stories.whyItMatters: Security lapses in widely used self-hosted bitcoin infrastructure raise concerns for merchants and developers who rely on these tools to avoid custodial risk.
whatToWatch: Whether the bounty leads to fund recovery
A technical post-mortem detailing the exploit
questions: How did the exploit occur and what was the attack vector?
Were funds beyond BTCPay's own affected, and how many users were impacted?

sources.title: BTCPay Server Offers a 3 Bitcoin Bounty for Recovery of Stolen Funds After Wallet Exploit

stories.title: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum Is Betting Its Future on Quantum Security and AI
stories.summary: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin said the network's long-term roadmap centers on building quantum-resistant security and integrating AI, according to Decrypt. The comments frame these as priority areas for Ethereum's continued development.
stories.whyItMatters: Buterin's stated priorities signal where Ethereum's protocol development and research resources are likely to concentrate in coming years, which matters to developers and long-term holders alike.
whatToWatch: Concrete proposals or EIPs addressing quantum resistance
Any timeline Ethereum sets for implementing these priorities
questions: What specific technical changes would quantum-resistant Ethereum require?
How would AI integration concretely change the protocol or its tooling?

sources.title: Vitalik Buterin Says Ethereum Is Betting Its Future on Quantum Security and AI

stories.title: Hackers Drain $8 Million From Crypto Exchange in Two-Blockchain Attack
stories.summary: According to Decrypt, hackers stole roughly $8 million from a crypto exchange in an attack that spanned two separate blockchains. Details on the exact method and affected chains were not specified in the report.
stories.whyItMatters: Exchange breaches that exploit weaknesses across multiple chains highlight ongoing custody and security risks for platforms holding customer funds.
whatToWatch: The exchange's public disclosure of what was exploited
Whether stolen funds are traced, frozen, or recovered
questions: Which exchange and which two blockchains were involved?
Were customer funds directly affected, and will they be made whole?

sources.title: Hackers Drain $8 Million From Crypto Exchange Across Two Blockchains

stories.title: Coinsbuy Exchange Loses $8 Million in Coordinated Two-Blockchain Attack
stories.summary: CoinDesk reports that crypto exchange Coinsbuy lost approximately $8 million in a coordinated attack executed across two blockchains. The exchange has not yet detailed the full scope of the incident.
stories.whyItMatters: Another exchange-level breach adds to a string of custody incidents that keep security and counterparty risk front and center for crypto users and institutions.
whatToWatch: Coinsbuy's official statement and remediation steps
Whether law enforcement or blockchain analytics firms trace the funds
questions: What vulnerability allowed a coordinated attack across two chains?
Will affected users be reimbursed, and by when?

stories.title: Contentious BIP-110 Bitcoin Branch Stalls Out After Two Blocks
stories.summary: A Bitcoin branch built around the proposed BIP-110 change stalled after producing just two blocks, with the gap versus the main chain widening, according to Cointelegraph. CoinDesk framed the episode as the market itself settling a contentious protocol dispute without central coordination.
stories.whyItMatters: How the Bitcoin ecosystem resolves disputes over proposed protocol changes — through voluntary adoption or rejection rather than a central authority — is a recurring test of the network's governance model.
whatToWatch: Whether BIP-110 proponents attempt to relaunch the branch
Hash rate and node support metrics for the branch versus the main chain
questions: What does BIP-110 actually propose to change?
Is the stall a permanent end to the effort or a temporary setback?

sources.title: Bitcoin's BIP-110 episode is free-market capitalism in purest form
BIP-110 Bitcoin branch stalls after two blocks as gap widens

stories.title: Trump Media's Bitcoin Holdings Shrink as Crypto Losses Hit $361 Million
stories.summary: Trump Media's bitcoin treasury has shrunk in value amid crypto-related losses totaling $361 million, according to CoinDesk. The report ties the decline to the company's exposure to bitcoin price moves.
stories.whyItMatters: The episode illustrates the balance-sheet risk companies take on when holding significant bitcoin reserves, particularly one with a high public profile.
whatToWatch: The company's next earnings disclosure on treasury holdings
Whether Trump Media adjusts its bitcoin treasury strategy
questions: How much bitcoin does the company still hold?
Are the losses realized or still unrealized on paper?

sources.title: Trump Media’s bitcoin holdings shrink as crypto losses hit $361 million

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs See Inflow Spike Following Major Exchange Hack
stories.summary: Bitcoin exchange-traded funds saw a jump in inflows following a large hack at a crypto exchange, according to Bitcoin Magazine. The report suggests investors may be shifting toward regulated ETF products after the security incident.
stories.whyItMatters: If security incidents at exchanges are pushing capital toward regulated ETF wrappers, it reflects how custody risk shapes investor behavior and could reinforce the ETF channel's growth.
whatToWatch: Whether the inflow spike persists in subsequent flow data
Which specific ETFs saw the largest inflows
questions: How directly is the inflow spike tied to the hack versus other market factors?
Is this a durable shift in investor preference or a short-term reaction?

sources.title: Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds See Spike In Inflows Following Huge Hack

stories.title: Bitdeer Boosts Bitcoin Mining Output Nearly Fivefold in Q2
stories.summary: Bitcoin miner Bitdeer increased its mining output by close to five times in the second quarter, according to Cointelegraph. The report does not detail the specific drivers behind the jump.
stories.whyItMatters: A sharp rise in output from a major public miner signals expanding hash rate capacity, which affects network security and the competitive economics among miners.
whatToWatch: Bitdeer's Q3 output and capital expenditure disclosures
Market and stock reaction to the reported growth
questions: Was the increase driven by new hardware, hosting capacity, or both?
How are margins holding up amid rising network difficulty?

sources.title: Bitdeer increased Bitcoin mining output by nearly fivefold in Q2

stories.title: Bitcoin Slips as Oil Surges 5% on Hormuz Disappointment
stories.summary: Bitcoin gave back weekend gains as oil prices jumped 5% following disappointment tied to developments around the Strait of Hormuz, per Cointelegraph. The move reflects a broader risk-off shift tied to energy markets rather than a crypto-specific catalyst.
stories.whyItMatters: The pullback is a reminder that bitcoin remains sensitive to macro and geopolitical shocks, particularly moves in energy markets that ripple through risk assets.
whatToWatch: Further developments around the Hormuz situation and oil prices
Whether bitcoin's correlation with oil/risk sentiment persists
questions: How durable is the observed link between oil moves and bitcoin here?
Is this a one-off reaction or the start of a sustained risk-off period?

sources.title: Bitcoin price slip wipes weekend gains as oil surge hits 5% on Hormuz disappointment

stories.title: BlackRock Launches Two Canadian ETFs, One With 3% Bitcoin Allocation
stories.summary: BlackRock has launched two new exchange-traded funds in Canada, with one of them allocating 3% of its portfolio to bitcoin, according to Cointelegraph. The move extends BlackRock's crypto-inclusive product lineup beyond the U.S. market.
stories.whyItMatters: A top asset manager embedding bitcoin into diversified, non-U.S. retail products signals continued mainstreaming of crypto exposure through traditional fund structures.
whatToWatch: Fund inflows and performance for the new Canadian ETFs
Whether BlackRock rolls out similar bitcoin-inclusive funds in other markets
questions: What other assets make up the fund alongside its bitcoin allocation?
Will the 3% allocation be actively rebalanced over time?

stories.title: Bitcoin Volatility Cools, but Downside Protection Still Pricey
stories.summary: Bitcoin's realized volatility has dropped sharply even as bitcoin topped $65,000, yet options traders are still paying a premium for downside protection, according to CoinDesk. The elevated cost of puts comes as U.S. inflation data is due later this week.
stories.whyItMatters: A persistent skew toward downside hedging despite calm spot price action suggests traders remain wary of a shock, which is useful context ahead of a market-moving data release.
whatToWatch: This week's U.S. inflation data and bitcoin's reaction
Changes in options skew and implied volatility around the print
questions: What specifically is driving continued demand for downside protection?
Will realized volatility stay low if the inflation data surprises?

sources.title: Bitcoin volatility is in meltdown, but downside protection still commands a premium
